clue.text: US city supplying capital for Israel

definitions.meaning: the state capital of Oregon, or the Massachusetts town of witch-trial fame
the ancient biblical name for Jerusalem, as in Psalm 76 and Genesis 14

explanation.surface: An American city is somehow providing Israel with its capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Salem is the short biblical name of Jerusalem, and the second half of the longer name, which is the joke behind 'supplying'.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregon's state capital bears the name, and the Bible uses it for the city of Melchizedek, taken as Jerusalem.

clue.text: Textiles frequently get sold in parts of ground

indicators.note: the first two pieces are set within the turf pieces

parts.note: sods are pieces of turf
oft is an old word for often
goods that go are sold

explanation.surface: Fabrics are often sold off in plots of land.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabrics and clothing are sold as a class of merchandise distinguished from hardware.

clue.text: Mark new sheets etc.

parts.note: a line is a mark

explanation.surface: Label the new bedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Household fabric goods such as bedsheets and tablecloths are collectively called by this name.

clue.text: Girl has spoken of town's leading citizen

parts.note: May is a girl's name
oral means spoken

explanation.surface: A girl has made a speech about the town's top dignitary.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes what belongs to a town's civic head.

clue.text: It's difficult to get through this broth, the king found

definitions.text: It's difficult to get through this

parts.note: pea soup is a thick broth
ER, Edwardus Rex, is a king's cipher

explanation.surface: A king discovers the broth is too thick to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a whole phrase: a thick yellow London fog that was hard to see or move through.
explanation.definitionFit: A dense smog gave its name from thick soup, so people struggled to see their way through it.

clue.text: Stout and wine left at end of party

parts.note: port is a fortified wine

indicators.note: the final letter of party is taken

explanation.surface: Beer and wine are left over when the party finishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stout' looks like the beer, but it is the adjective meaning plump.
explanation.definitionFit: A stout person is plump and heavy-set.

clue.text: Nurse may require treatment for arterial trouble

indicators.note: the letters need working on and come out rearranged

explanation.surface: A nurse may need to treat a problem with the arteries.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulge in a weakened blood-vessel wall is a dangerous arterial condition.

clue.text: Jewel catches involuntary movement of the eyes

indicators.note: the jewel holds the twitch inside it

parts.note: an opal is a gem
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: A gem catches the light and makes the eyes twitch.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective refers to sight or the eye.

clue.text: Preparation for ghost appearing

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a vision is an apparition

explanation.surface: Getting ready for a spectre to show up.
explanation.definitionFit: Making provision is preparing in advance for a need.

clue.text: Variery of products new in style

indicators.note: the letter for new goes inside the fashion word

parts.note: the rage is the current fashion or style

explanation.surface: A selection of goods in the latest fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A company's product line is the spread of goods it offers.

clue.text: Not committed to deliver on idea

indicators.note: in this across clue 'on' places the word for deliver after the word for idea

parts.note: a fancy is a notion or idea
to deliver a captive is to free them

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to promise to deliver on an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone footloose has no romantic attachment or obligation, so is uncommitted.

clue.text: Old character causing irritation in the flesh

definitions.meaning: a runic letter used in Old English for the 'th' sound
a sharp spine on a plant, as in the phrase for a persistent annoyance

explanation.surface: A figure from the past is like a splinter under the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A rose's prickle lodges in skin and irritates, and the same name belongs to an obsolete letter of the alphabet.

clue.text: Usual rehearsal tending not to be done in theatre

definitions.text: tending not to be done in theatre

parts.note: general means usual or common
a practice is a rehearsal

explanation.surface: A normal run-through that the actors decide not to stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Theatre' and 'rehearsal' suggest the stage, but this is medicine: a family doctor's caring ('tending') work, not surgery in an operating theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: A family doctor's surgery treats patients without operating, so its care happens outside the operating room.

clue.text: It'S a revelation for motorists to be surrounded by approval in Spain

indicators.note: the motorists' letters are placed within the Spanish cheer

parts.note: ole is the Spanish shout of approval
the RAC is the Royal Automobile Club, a British motoring organisation

explanation.surface: Drivers are delighted to be cheered on by Spanish crowds.
explanation.definitionFit: A divine pronouncement from a shrine such as Delphi was a revelation of the future.

clue.text: Subtle diversification for St Michael

indicators.note: diversifying the letters spreads them into a new order

explanation.surface: A clever variety offered by the Marks and Spencer brand.
explanation.walkthrough: Subtle is the conman alchemist in Ben Jonson's play The Alchemist; St Michael was the Marks and Spencer house brand.
explanation.definitionFit: Ben Jonson's comedy names its fraudulent gold-maker Subtle, so the character's name stands for his trade.

clue.text: David is the fortune teller around the sea-front

indicators.note: the palm-reader's letters go round the front of 'sea'

parts.note: a palmist tells fortunes from the hand
the front letter of sea

explanation.surface: David is the seaside fortune teller on the promenade.
explanation.definitionFit: King David is traditionally credited as author of the biblical Psalms.

clue.text: Exhaustion making dissenter collapse

indicators.note: the rebel falls apart, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fatigue makes a rebel finally collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhaustion is extreme weariness.

clue.text: Jockey for position in motor cycle trial

definitions.meaning: to struggle or push to get ahead of others
an off-road motorbike race over rough ground

explanation.surface: Riders compete for places in a motorbike race.
explanation.definitionFit: Jostling for places is a mad rush, and a cross-country motorbike race over rough terrain shares the name.

clue.text: Fire people — in which event, members are given cover

definitions.text: in which event, members are given cover

parts.note: to sack is to dismiss or fire
a race is a people

explanation.surface: Staff are fired, and then members are given insurance cover.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'members' are legs, covered by the sack in this school sports-day event.
explanation.definitionFit: In this sports-day contest, the competitors' legs are put into bags as they hop along.

clue.text: Take someone's watch with ease

definitions.meaning: to take over guard duty from a sentry

explanation.surface: Stealing a person's wristwatch with no trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A replacement sentry takes over a guard's shift, and a painkiller soothes and lessens pain.

clue.text: Standard of a forbidding type

definitions.meaning: read as one who bans, a prohibiter

explanation.surface: A flag of a rather forbidding kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A flag carried aloft is a standard, and someone who prohibits things could jokingly be one who bans.

clue.text: One doesn't believe article is subsumed in a Times leader

indicators.note: the article and 'is' are taken inside the outer letters
the first letter of Times is taken

parts.note: the is the definite article

explanation.surface: An article is absorbed into a Times editorial.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who denies God's existence is a non-believer.

clue.text: A religious scholar came first, but went off

parts.note: DD is a Doctor of Divinity
led means was in front

explanation.surface: A theologian was in the lead but then departed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Went off' is not leaving but going bad, as eggs do.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotten eggs are spoilt or gone bad.

clue.text: Housewife can supply these parts of old lady's street

definitions.text: Housewife can supply these parts of old lady's street

parts.words: Housewife can supply these parts of old lady's street
parts.note: a housewife is also a small sewing kit; the Old Lady of the City of London is the Bank of England, whose street name splits into two sewing items

explanation.surface: A homemaker can provide parts of an elderly woman's road.
explanation.walkthrough: The Bank of England, nicknamed the Old Lady, stands on a London street whose name is made of two sewing items; 'housewife' is an old word for a sewing kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A pocket sewing kit, called a housewife, holds the two basic tools for stitching.

clue.text: New note transformed this composition

indicators.note: the word note is changed into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A fresh note changed this piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece for nine players or voices is a musical composition.

clue.text: Call up girl without permission

indicators.note: used in its old sense of outside, so the girl's name surrounds the approval

parts.note: Eve is a girl's name
OK is permission

explanation.surface: Phone a girl without being allowed to.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke is to summon up a memory or feeling.

clue.text: Person speaking in body of church is unworldly

indicators.note: the speaker's letter is put inside the church body

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church
I is what a person speaking calls themselves

explanation.surface: Someone talking in the main part of a church is innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone innocent and inexperienced lacks worldly wisdom.

clue.text: Atlantic port where a M. Bleriot came to grief

indicators.note: a crash wrecks the words, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The port where the French aviator crashed.
explanation.walkthrough: Louis Blériot was the French aviator who first flew the Channel; 'came to grief' shuffles A, M and BLERIOT.
explanation.definitionFit: The Maryland city is a major harbour on Chesapeake Bay, which opens on the Atlantic.

clue.text: What Katy Did, for example? That proves one's right

definitions.meaning: a book title naming a deed, the children's novel by Susan Coolidge
a legal document proving ownership of property

explanation.surface: A children's book name serving as proof of ownership.
explanation.definitionFit: The deed showing legal ownership of land proves the owner's right to it, and the novel's name is literally a title about a deed.

clue.text: Having given up opening, put pressure on lock

indicators.note: the word for put pressure loses its first letter

parts.note: to stress is to put pressure on

explanation.surface: Unable to open it, someone forces the lock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lock' looks like a door lock but is a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock of hair is a curl or ringlet.
